Aurora Gaming is a Serbian professional esports organization.

Timeline

[edit]
  • 2022
  • 2023
  • 2024
  • 2025
  • 2026
  • Show All
  • August 31st - Aurora Gaming enter Counter-Strike with the signings of delus1onn, KaiR0N-, Lack1, RAiLWAY, sugaR, starix and bullet, with the latter two joining as coach and assistant coach, respectively. [1]
  • October 11th - Aurora Gaming part ways with RAiLWAY. [2]
  • November 1st - Aurora Gaming part ways with sugaR. [3]
  • November 9th - Aurora Gaming acquire Norwi from forZe. [4]
  • November 22nd - Aurora Gaming transfer-list KaiR0N-. [5]
  • December 25th - Aurora Gaming acquire KENSi from forZe. [6]
  • December 28th - Aurora Gaming part ways with delus1onn and acquire lattykk from VP.Prodigy. [7]
  • January 8th - KaiR0N- is acquired by Virtus.pro. [8]
  • January 9th - Aurora Gaming sign SELLTER. [9]
  • May 2nd - Aurora Gaming part ways with starix. [10]
  • June 24th - Aurora Gaming sign innersh1ne as coach. [11]
  • September 30th - Aurora Gaming part ways with innersh1ne. [12]
  • November 1st - Aurora Gaming part ways with bullet. [13]
  • November 8th - Aurora Gaming bench lattykk, acquire deko from 1win, and sign hooch as coach. [14]
  • November 30th - Aurora Gaming acquire brain from 1win as an assistant coach. [15]
  • January 24th - Aurora Gaming bench SELLTER. [16]
  • February 13th - Aurora Gaming bench hooch. [17]
  • February 27th - SELLTER is acquired by FORZE Esports. [18]
  • April 1st - Aurora Gaming promote brain from assistant coach to head coach. [19]
  • April 2nd - Aurora Gaming acquire r3salt from FORZE Esports. Additionally, they part ways with hooch by mutual agreement. [20][21]
  • April 5th - lattykk is acquired by 1win. [22]
  • August 17th - Aurora Gaming replace r3salt with clax in a swap deal with 9Pandas. [23]
  • September 13th - Aurora Gaming acquire XomA from Virtus.pro as an assistant coach. [24]
  • November 28th - deko steps down from the active lineup and takes a break from competitive Counter-Strike. [25]
  • December 5th - Aurora Gaming bench Lack1 and swap brain and XomA's roles as coach and assistant coach. [26][27]
  • December 29th - Aurora Gaming promote gr1ks from the academy team. [28]
  • December 31st - Aurora Gaming acquire Patsi from PARIVISION. [29]
  • January 5th - Aurora Gaming part ways with brain. [30]
  • February 20th - Lack1 is acquired by GUN5 Esports. [31]
  • March 1st - Aurora Gaming sign StRoGo. [32]
  • April 5th - Aurora Gaming bench their roster and acquire the roster of Eternal Fire, consisting of XANTARES, MAJ3R, Wicadia, woxic, jottAAA, and Fabre, the latter as coach. [33][34]
  • May 1st - Norwi, KENSi, clax, gr1ks, Patsi, and XomA are acquired by Astrum. [35]
  • July 12th - Aurora Gaming sign gAndhi as an analyst. [36]
  • December 23rd - Aurora Gaming sign forg1 as a content creator. [37]
  • December 27th - Aurora Gaming bench jottAAA by mutual agreement and acquire soulfly from Fire Flux Esports as his replacement. [38][39]
  • February 2nd - jottAAA is loaned to Eternal Fire. [40]
  • June 29th - Aurora Gaming bench Fabre. [41]
  • July 2nd - Aurora Gaming bench MAJ3R and soulfly. [42][43]
  • July 3rd - Aurora Gaming sign Jimpphat and ashhh, the latter as the team's coach. [44][45]
  • July 8th - Aurora Gaming acquire kyxsan from Team Falcons to complete their roster. [46]
  • August 23rd - jottAAA and soulfly are acquired by Eternal Fire, the former on a permanent basis. [47]
  • September 11th - Fabre is acquired by Eternal Fire. [48]
